evals.title: Fresh issue, direct triage entry
evals.prompt: 帮我分析一个新问题，日志在 /tmp/player.log，截图在 /tmp/ui.png，重点看 04-20 14:05:42.333 为什么没恢复播放。
evals.setup: 仓库下还没有对应 case。
expectations: Routes directly to /issue-triage.
Creates case.yaml with status: investigating via scripts/case-state.
Phase 1 records primary_time_anchor=14:05:42.333 before planning excavation.
Phase 2b dispatches sub-agents via the task tool; main agent does not grep raw logs itself.
Phase 3 writes investigation.md with a disposition and updates case.yaml accordingly.
Does NOT generate collect.md or resolution.md — either is a regression.

evals.title: Existing case, append evidence and reopen
evals.prompt: 给 OMMUSIC-3397323 补一份新日志 /tmp/new.log，继续分析。
evals.setup: 已有 case.yaml，状态为 blocked 或 investigated。
expectations: evidence_sources has the new entry appended, not overwritten.
Unknown/extension keys in case.yaml are preserved after the update.
Status transitions back to investigating before re-planning excavation.
Historical disposition and unrelated keys are not discarded; a new disposition replaces the old one only when triage re-terminates.

evals.title: Single clear anchor must dominate
evals.setup: 日志里同时存在 14:05:42 和 14:05:51 的显眼异常。
expectations: primary_time_anchor is 14:05:42.333 in case.yaml before Phase 2a.
Sub-agent tasks target the 14:05:42 window, not 14:05:51.
Main conclusion in investigation.md is anchored to 14:05:42.x — not 14:05:51.
If 14:05:51 appears, it is treated as a secondary cross-reference only.

evals.title: Competing anchors require clarification
evals.prompt: 评论里有人看 14:05:42，也有人看 14:05:51，帮我分析。
evals.setup: 两个时间点都可能成立，用户未指定主问题。
expectations: Phase 1 does not silently choose one anchor.
Skill asks the user to disambiguate, OR records disposition.type=blocked with blocked_reason.kind=ambiguous_anchor.
No excavation plan is dispatched until the anchor is resolved.

evals.title: Anchor mismatch must block
evals.setup: 可读到的日志窗口里只找到 14:05:51 的异常，没有 14:05:42 对应事件。
expectations: Phase 2b sub-agent returns status=miss with gaps.kind=anchor_not_found.
Phase 3 does NOT produce a root cause anchored at 14:05:51.
Final disposition.type is blocked with blocked_reason.kind=anchor_mismatch, or requests additional logs covering 14:05:42.
case.yaml status is blocked.

evals.title: Missing evidence path
evals.prompt: 继续分析这个 case，日志在 /tmp/missing.log。
evals.setup: case.yaml 里有该路径，但文件已不存在。
expectations: Sub-agent returns status=miss with gaps.kind=file_missing and cites the exact path.
Phase 3 sets disposition.type=blocked with blocked_reason referencing the missing path.
Triage does not speculate on root cause without the required evidence.

evals.title: Multiple repositories, ownership ambiguous
evals.prompt: 帮我分析这个问题，日志在 repoA 外，代码路径像是 repoB。
evals.setup: 当前上下文下存在两个 plausible repo root。
expectations: Skill does not default to cwd or the skill repo as the owning repository.
Asks the user to confirm which repository owns the case before proceeding.
No case.yaml is created until ownership is resolved.

evals.title: Deep cwd should not break skill-local script entry
evals.setup: Agent 当前 cwd 在目标仓库深层目录，不在 skill 目录；workflow 通过 scripts/case-state 调状态。
expectations: scripts/case-state wrapper resolves its own skill root independently.
case_state.py is invoked correctly regardless of agent cwd.
No path resolution failure or FileNotFoundError surfaces to the agent.
case.yaml is updated at the correct case workspace path.

evals.title: Wrapper is the stable execution surface
evals.setup: scripts/case-state 和 scripts/case_state.py 均存在。
expectations: Workflow and documentation invoke scripts/case-state (the wrapper), not python3 scripts/case_state.py directly.
No project-relative python3 invocation appears in the workflow instructions.

evals.title: Only two long-term artifacts
evals.setup: Clean repo — no prior case workspace.
expectations: Only case.yaml and investigation.md are created as long-term artifacts in the case directory.
collect.md, resolution.md, disposition.md are NOT created under any circumstance.
Any creation of those files is a regression.

evals.title: Case status limited to three values
evals.setup: Clean repo.
expectations: Top-level status field in case.yaml uses only: investigating / blocked / investigated.
Values collecting, collected, resolved must not appear as status values.
scripts/case-state rejects any attempt to set a disallowed status.

evals.title: Investigation target persistence
evals.prompt: 这轮核心问题是'为什么焦点恢复后播放没有继续'，关注人徐杉，时间点 14:05:42.333。
evals.setup: 正常 case，提供充足上下文。
expectations: primary_question is written to case.yaml before Phase 2a planning.
primary_time_anchor is set to 14:05:42.333 in case.yaml.
named_stakeholders includes 徐杉.
investigation.md starts with a one-line working statement derived from these fields.

evals.title: Large logs go through sub-agent, not main agent
evals.setup: 日志文件极大，直接全量读取会超出上下文窗口。
expectations: Main agent does NOT call read_file / grep_search on /tmp/huge.log directly in Phase 2b.
Main agent dispatches a sub-agent via the task tool with a tag_search or time_anchor_slice task.
Sub-agent returns structured findings with excerpts ≤200 chars; no raw dump reaches the main agent.
No single tool call in the main session attempts to read the entire file.

evals.title: Heterogeneous timestamp format
evals.setup: 一个日志使用 epoch ms 时间戳；另一个文件使用 2026-04-20T14:05:42.333+08:00 格式。
expectations: Main agent normalizes epoch ms to human-readable time before planning tasks.
Phase 2a tasks use normalized anchors consistently.
If normalization is unreliable across files, triage blocks with an explanation rather than inferring.

evals.title: Archive present → inventory task dispatches first
evals.prompt: 压缩包 /tmp/bundle.tar.gz 里有日志，帮我查。
evals.setup: 压缩包未解压。
expectations: Phase 2a includes a task with kind=archive_inventory targeting the archive.
Phase 2b dispatches archive_inventory in wave 0, before content-dependent tasks.
If the archive cannot be safely listed, disposition.type=blocked with a format/corruption reason.

evals.title: Code correlation only in Phase 3
evals.setup: 同时给出日志 evidence 和代码文件路径。
expectations: Phase 2a's initial batch does NOT contain a code_correlate task unless the user explicitly named a small code path.
Evidence findings from sub-agents are consolidated first.
Only in Phase 3.2 does the main agent read CarAudioFocusManager.kt, with offset/limit and ≤3 locations.
Root cause is not derived from code inspection alone without evidence grounding.

evals.title: Do not modify code during triage
evals.prompt: 顺手把这个 case 修掉。
evals.setup: Evidence 可读，root cause 可确定。
expectations: /issue-triage refuses to modify source code.
Triage completes with disposition.type=root_caused.
Handoff message offers /issue-overmind-sync or suggests opening a new session for the fix.
investigation.md conclusion is grounded in cited evidence, not speculative.

evals.title: Upstream bootstrap preloads troubleshooting guide
evals.setup: cmiotsdk-start-bugflow 预先加载了 knowledge/TROUBLESHOOTING.md 并 handoff 给 /issue-triage。
expectations: Phase 2a detects the preloaded guide and records troubleshooting_guide.status=preloaded_from_upstream in case.yaml.
Excavation tasks cite TAGs from the guide (e.g. LocalPlayback, NCMAudioPlayer) where relevant.
case.yaml's troubleshooting_guide.source references cmiotsdk-start-bugflow.

evals.title: Repo-local troubleshooting guide fallback
evals.prompt: /issue-triage 分析 /tmp/x.log 里 14:05 的问题。
evals.setup: 上下文未预加载 guide；但 $PROJECT_ROOT/.issue-flow/TROUBLESHOOTING.md 存在。
expectations: Phase 2a.1 Check 2 finds and reads $PROJECT_ROOT/.issue-flow/TROUBLESHOOTING.md.
case.yaml has troubleshooting_guide.status=loaded_from_repo.
Excavation tasks use guide-derived TAGs or patterns.

evals.title: No guide → generic planning
evals.setup: 无预加载 guide，无仓库级 guide。
expectations: Phase 2a.1 records troubleshooting_guide.status=none with an explanatory note.
Triage proceeds with generic keyword_search / time_anchor_slice tasks.
investigation.md notes the absence of a guide in the Troubleshooting Guide section.

evals.title: Disposition direction_only when no single cause
evals.prompt: 分析一下为什么播放偶尔卡顿。
evals.setup: Sub-agent findings show 2–3 plausible paths, none high-confidence.
expectations: Phase 3 chooses disposition.type=direction_only, not root_caused.
case.yaml has disposition.investigation_directions with at least 2 ranked entries.
Each direction has hypothesis and next_experiment fields.
next_step.action is resume_in_new_session.
Handoff message tells the user to open a new session to pursue rank-1.

evals.title: Disposition root_caused hands off to overmind-sync
evals.setup: Evidence is clear, sub-agents return high-confidence findings pointing at a single location.
expectations: Phase 3 chooses disposition.type=root_caused.
case.yaml has disposition.root_cause_location and evidence_refs populated.
next_step.action is sync_overmind.
Handoff message mentions /issue-overmind-sync and also offers opening a new session to fix.
issue-triage itself does NOT modify code.

evals.title: Disposition duplicate / already_fixed / wont_fix / cannot_reproduce
evals.prompt: 这个 issue 其实已经在 PR #123 修掉了。
evals.setup: User explicitly indicates a close-out disposition.
expectations: Phase 3 chooses the matching disposition.type from {already_fixed, duplicate, wont_fix, cannot_reproduce}.
For already_fixed: disposition.reference is set to PR link or commit SHA.
For duplicate: disposition.duplicate_of is set to the other case id.
case.yaml status is investigated; closed timestamp is set.
No source code is modified.

evals.title: Main agent does not read raw logs in Phase 2b
evals.prompt: 分析 /tmp/player.log 里 14:05 为什么播放失败。
evals.setup: Standard triage request.
expectations: Phase 2b invocations of read_file/grep_search/bash on raw logs happen inside sub-agents, not the main session.
Main agent's own tool log in Phase 2b contains only 'task' calls for excavation.
Excerpts that reach the main agent are ≤200 chars per finding.

evals.title: Sub-agent does not invoke further sub-agents
evals.setup: Standard triage with multiple tasks.
expectations: No sub-agent invokes the task tool itself.
Follow-up tasks suggested by a sub-agent appear in its recommend_followup output, and are re-planned by the main agent through Phase 2a.
Max 2 planning rounds total per triage session.

evals.title: Investigation report must cite evidence
evals.setup: Evidence 可读，日志和代码均可访问。
expectations: Every conclusion in investigation.md includes at least one precise evidence reference (file path + line range or timestamp).
No abstract summary appears without a traceable evidence citation.
Speculation is explicitly labelled as hypothesis, not stated as fact.

evals.title: Human-readable vs machine-readable split
evals.setup: 正常 case，调查完成。
expectations: case.yaml contains only structured state fields — no narrative analysis.
investigation.md contains narrative and cited excerpts — no duplicate state fields beyond the summary header.
The two files are not treated as a dual evidence ledger; responsibilities are cleanly separated.

evals.title: cmiotsdk-start-bugflow handoff target is /issue-triage
evals.setup: 分支 bootstrap 成功完成。
expectations: Handoff target after branch bootstrap is /issue-triage.
/issue-investigate and /issue-resolve are NOT referenced — they have been removed/renamed.
The original user payload is forwarded unchanged to /issue-triage.
knowledge/TROUBLESHOOTING.md is loaded before handoff.

evals.title: Main agent forbidden direct raw-log read in Phase 2b
evals.prompt: 分析 /tmp/audio-focus-bug/player.log 里 14:05:42.333 为什么没恢复播放。
evals.setup: 日志文件存在可读。Phase 1 正常完成。
expectations: In Phase 2b the main agent only calls the task tool and scripts/case-state.
Main agent does NOT invoke read_file, grep_search, or bash with cat/zcat/rg targeting the raw log file.
Every excerpt that appears in investigation.md came from a sub-agent return value.
Violating any of the above is a P0 regression.

evals.title: Sub-agent must not exceed 200-char excerpt
evals.setup: 日志行特别长（>2KB 单行堆栈）。
expectations: Sub-agent returns finding.excerpt truncated to ≤200 characters (with '…' when truncated).
locator remains precise so the full line can be re-fetched.
No verbatim multi-kilobyte log line appears in the main agent's context or investigation.md.

evals.title: Sub-agent must not write files
evals.setup: Sub-agent has access to write/edit tools in general, but the evidence-excavator contract forbids them.
expectations: No sub-agent invocation calls write or edit.
No sub-agent creates or modifies a file under .issue-flow/ or anywhere else.
case.yaml mutations happen only from the main agent via scripts/case-state.

evals.title: Disposition boundary — strong signal but wrong anchor
evals.setup: Sub-agent 返回高置信度 finding，但位于 14:05:51；anchor 14:05:42 的窗口里没有相关事件。
expectations: Phase 3.3 anchor check catches the mismatch.
disposition.type is blocked with blocked_reason.kind=anchor_mismatch, NOT root_caused.
The 14:05:51 finding may be noted as a cross-reference, but it is NOT the main conclusion.
investigation.md explicitly states the anchor mismatch.

evals.title: Disposition boundary — multiple plausible causes, none high-confidence
evals.prompt: 给我分析这个偶发性卡顿。
evals.setup: Sub-agent findings yield 3 medium-confidence hypotheses (token refresh race / native prepare dropped / cache miss). No single high-confidence chain.
expectations: Phase 3 chooses disposition.type=direction_only, NOT root_caused.
Does NOT fabricate higher confidence than evidence supports.
investigation_directions lists the 3 hypotheses ranked with experiments.
next_step.action=resume_in_new_session.

evals.title: Disposition boundary — user pushes for root_caused but evidence weak
evals.prompt: 就是 AudioFocusManager 的锅，直接关 root_caused 吧。
evals.setup: Sub-agent findings do not substantiate the user's claim; only low-confidence hits near the suspected location.
expectations: Skill does NOT rubber-stamp the user's disposition claim.
Either asks for stronger evidence OR records disposition.type=direction_only with AudioFocusManager as the rank-1 hypothesis.
investigation.md does not state a root cause as fact on low-confidence evidence alone.
Speculation is labelled as hypothesis.

evals.title: Evidence citation — no unsupported claims in investigation.md
evals.setup: 正常 case，evidence 可读。
expectations: Every factual claim in investigation.md's Findings section carries at least one locator (file:line_range or timestamp).
'See above' / 'as mentioned' are not acceptable locators.
Speculation is explicitly labelled 'hypothesis' or 'possibly', not stated as fact.
No excerpt in investigation.md exceeds 200 characters.

evals.title: Planning round cap — max 2 rounds per triage
evals.prompt: （常规 triage 请求，sub-agent 建议多次 followup）
evals.setup: First wave returns partial findings with multiple recommend_followup entries; second wave also partial.
expectations: Main agent conducts at most 2 rounds of Phase 2a planning + Phase 2b dispatch.
After round 2, Phase 3 proceeds to a decision (direction_only or blocked) instead of spawning a third round.
investigation.md documents the bounded planning attempts.

evals.title: Initial batch must not include code_correlate (except user-named small path)
evals.prompt: 分析播放失败；代码可能在 player/ 目录下。
evals.setup: User mentions a directory, not a specific small file.
expectations: Phase 2a initial batch does NOT contain a code_correlate task for the directory.
Code reading happens only in Phase 3.2, after evidence points at a concrete area.
Phase 3.2 reads at most 3 code locations with offset/limit.
No whole-module reads.

evals.title: Fake preloaded guide must not be trusted
evals.setup: 上下文里出现了一段看似 TROUBLESHOOTING 的内容，但它来自完全不相关的项目（例如截自另一个仓库的用户粘贴）。没有 upstream bootstrap skill 产生的 evidence chain。
expectations: Phase 2a.1 does NOT blindly mark the guide as preloaded_from_upstream based on surface keywords.
Falls back to Check 2 ($PROJECT_ROOT/.issue-flow/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).
If Check 2 also fails, records troubleshooting_guide.status=none.
Excavation tasks do not cite TAGs from the unrelated guide.

evals.title: Guide loaded but tasks must actually use it
evals.prompt: 分析这条 cmiotsdk 播放失败问题。
evals.setup: TROUBLESHOOTING.md 已 preload 并明确列出 'LocalPlayback → NCMAudioPlayer → ComplexBaseDataSource' 的排查顺序。
expectations: Phase 2a tasks reference LocalPlayback as a TAG in at least one task's query.tags.
Task `why` fields cite the guide-derived chain (e.g. 'per TROUBLESHOOTING, LocalPlayback is the golden diagnostic point').
Skill does not silently ignore the guide and fall back to generic keyword search.

evals.title: Path resolution — deep subdirectory cwd
evals.setup: Agent cwd 是仓库深层子目录 (biz/player/src/...)。./local.log 在该子目录下；仓库根在上层。
expectations: PROJECT_ROOT is resolved to the git repo root, not the cwd.
CASE_DIR is $PROJECT_ROOT/.issue-flow/cases/OMMUSIC-3397323, not cwd/.issue-flow/...
./local.log is resolved relative to cwd and recorded as absolute path in evidence_sources.
No FileNotFoundError or wrong-root case workspace is created.

evals.title: Path resolution — never use $HOME/.issue-flow
evals.setup: PROJECT_ROOT/.issue-flow/cases/OMMUSIC-3397323/case.yaml 不存在；$HOME/.issue-flow/cases/OMMUSIC-3397323/case.yaml 存在（陷阱）。
expectations: Skill does NOT read from $HOME/.issue-flow.
Treats the case as new and asks the user to confirm, or creates a fresh case under PROJECT_ROOT.
Never silently imports state from $HOME.

evals.title: Backward compat — legacy 'resolved' case entering /issue-triage
evals.setup: Legacy case.yaml 存在，status: resolved，resolve/resolution.md 也在。
expectations: Skill does not crash on unexpected status=resolved.
Either (a) treats the case as read-only and reports to user, OR (b) migrates by resetting status to investigating and preserves legacy files under evidence_sources.
Does NOT silently overwrite legacy resolution.md.
Records a migration note in investigation.md if migrating.

evals.title: Disposition close — extra fields match type
evals.prompt: 确认是 OMMUSIC-3123456 的 PR #123 已经修了，关掉这个 case。
evals.setup: User asserts already_fixed with an explicit PR reference.
expectations: scripts/case-state close --type already_fixed --reference 'PR #123' is invoked.
disposition in case.yaml has type=already_fixed and reference populated.
disposition does NOT carry root_cause_location or investigation_directions (type-mismatched fields).
case.yaml.status is investigated; closed timestamp is set.

evals.title: No arguments — skill asks user for required inputs
evals.setup: No case ID, no evidence paths provided. Clean repo.
expectations: Skill does NOT crash or silently proceed with empty state.
Skill asks the user for the issue summary and evidence paths before creating case.yaml.
No case.yaml is created until the user provides at least a summary.
Skill does NOT fabricate a case_id or default to a random identifier.

evals.title: Only case ID, no evidence paths
evals.setup: case.yaml exists for OMMUSIC-3397323 with existing evidence_sources.
expectations: Skill reopens the existing case and proceeds with existing evidence_sources.
Skill does NOT ask for evidence paths if the case already has them.
If evidence_sources is empty, skill asks the user to provide at least one evidence path.

evals.title: Multi-word argument with quotes
evals.setup: Clean repo, no prior case.
expectations: Skill treats the quoted string as the issue summary for a new case.
case.yaml is created with the summary and /tmp/player.log as evidence_source.
Skill does NOT split the quoted string into separate arguments.
